publishedRecords.name: Craigieburn Valley Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public club field; tow-belt ability and mountain-road preparation are required.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A volunteer-rooted Canterbury club field with rope tows, a steep access road and no resort-village gloss. Check the club's access and operating report before leaving Springfield.

publishedRecords.name: Broken River Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public club field reached by mountain road and inclinator; rope-tow skills are recommended.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A Canterbury club field where the trip includes a mountain road, an inclinator and nutcracker rope tows. Read the day's access report and arrive self-sufficient.

publishedRecords.name: Mt Olympus Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public club field via an exposed unsealed access road; rope-tow skills and chains may be required.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A high, south-facing club field at the end of a serious Canterbury access road. It runs rope tows rather than chairlifts, so check road, tow and opening advice first.

publishedRecords.name: Temple Basin Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public club field reached only by a steep walk from the Arthur's Pass highway; freight lift carries gear, not passengers.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: Temple Basin is a hike-in club field, not a drive-to resort. Allow for the steep walk from the highway; the goods lift moves packs while guests walk to the lodges and rope tows.

publishedRecords.name: Porters Alpine Resort
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public commercial ski area reached by an alpine access road.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A public Canterbury ski area with chairlift and surface-lift terrain. Check the official mountain-road report before driving up from Springfield.

publishedRecords.name: Mt Cheeseman Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public, family-oriented club field with an unsealed mountain road and surface tows.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A public Canterbury club field with T-bars and lodge culture rather than a commercial-resort setup. Check the access road and club operating notice before travel.

publishedRecords.name: Mt Lyford Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public family ski area via an unsealed alpine road; chains and suitable vehicles may be required.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A compact public ski area above the Mt Lyford village. The alpine road is part of the day, so use the operator's current access advice rather than treating Hanmer Springs as the field itself.

publishedRecords.name: Mt Dobson Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public family-operated field via a long unsealed access road.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A family-operated South Canterbury field with broad open terrain. Check the official road report before committing to the climb from Fairlie.

publishedRecords.name: Fox Peak Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public volunteer club field, natural-snow dependent, with rope tows and an unsealed access road.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A volunteer South Canterbury club field that opens when natural snow and staffing align. Rope-tow know-how and a road check matter more here than resort assumptions.

publishedRecords.name: Roundhill Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public commercial ski area reached by an unsealed mountain road.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A public Lake Tekapo ski area with family slopes and the long Heritage Express rope tow for experts. Check road and tow status on the official report.

publishedRecords.name: Ōhau Snow Fields
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public commercial ski area via an alpine gravel road.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A compact public field above Lake Ōhau with a chairlift and high-country views. Use the official road and field report before the drive from Twizel.

publishedRecords.name: Awakino Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public volunteer club field, natural-snow and staffing dependent, accessed by a private alpine road.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A small North Otago club field that operates when snow, volunteers and road conditions permit. Check directly with the club before travelling from Kurow.

publishedRecords.name: Rainbow Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public community-owned field via a steep alpine access road.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A community-owned field above Nelson Lakes with surface lifts and a serious mountain road. Check access, chains and opening status before leaving St Arnaud.

publishedRecords.name: Snow Farm NZ / Waiorau
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public Nordic cross-country ski area via the Pisa Range access road; no downhill chairlift ski field.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: Snow Farm is a Nordic and cross-country facility on the Pisa Range, not a downhill resort. This page describes outdoor weather for its groomed trail network; check trail and road status with the operator.

publishedRecords.name: Tukino Ski Field
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public club field on Ruapehu's eastern side; four-wheel-drive alpine-road access and tow capability may be required.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A remote club field on Ruapehu's eastern flank with surface tows and no resort village. Follow Tukino's current 4WD road, booking and operating advice.

publishedRecords.name: Manganui Ski Area
publishedRecords.accessModel: Public volunteer club field in Egmont National Park; natural-snow and staffing dependent with a walk from the car park.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: A volunteer club field on Taranaki that opens when natural snow and staffing line up. Expect a walk from the road end and check the club report before leaving New Plymouth.

publishedRecords.name: Snowplanet
publishedRecords.accessModel: Ticketed indoor snow dome beside State Highway 1; climate-controlled and not dependent on mountain weather.
publishedRecords.publicCopy: Snowplanet is an indoor, climate-controlled snow dome in Auckland — not an outdoor mountain. No mountain forecast, powder alert or natural outdoor-condition claim is provided for this facility.
